display_information.name: Meeting Mouse
display_information.description: Find a meeting time without leaving Slack.
display_information.long_description: Start an availability poll in a channel with /meet. Everyone clicks the times they're free, shown in their own time zone. The message updates live with a grid of who is free when and the best times, and the organizer locks in a final time with an Add to Google Calendar link.

shortcuts.name: Find a meeting time
shortcuts.description: Start an availability poll in a channel

slash_commands.description: Start an availability poll in this channel
Start an availability poll in this channel (same as /meet)
